name: Lightning Ring

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: a bit of fur and a glass ring

summary: Chosen creatures entering, ending a turn in, or swept into your 10-foot Emanation save Constitution: 3d6 Lightning + 3d6 Thunder and Deafened for 1 minute on failure, half damage only on success. While active, a Magic action emits a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line: Dexterity save against 6d6 Lightning, half on success.
